name: pols-vo-1
text: In old Ahmedabad, some house fronts are not houses. They're escape routes. [short pause] This is a pol. Fifty to a hundred homes sharing walls... behind one gate. [pause] Why build a street like a fortress? In the 1700s, as Mughals and Marathas fought over the city, its old walls stopped keeping robbers out. So neighbours locked themselves in. A guard lived above the gate. Narrow passages, some disguised as the fronts of homes, let families slip away in an attack. Even the rooftops joined, house to house. [pause] In 2017, this old city became India's first World Heritage City. So that plain old door... is it a house? Or a way out?
